name: 收获损失率（机器/人工）评估

map.📖 查看「收获损失率（机器/人工）评估使用指南」: 📖 View the "Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessment Guide"
map.收获损失率（机器/人工）评估是做什么的？: What does Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessment do?
map.如何使用收获损失率（机器/人工）评估？: How do I use Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessment?
map.收获损失率（机器/人工）评估适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessment best for?
map.输入收获前后作物重量，计算机器/人工收获损失率并评估作业质量: Enter pre- and post-harvest crop weights to compute machine/manual harvest loss rate and assess operation quality.
map.损失率 = (落粒 + 漏割 + 夹带等损失量) ÷ 实测可收总量 × 100%: Loss rate = (shattered + missed-cut + entrained losses) / measured recoverable total x 100%; measured recoverable total = theoretical yield - harvested amount + losses.
map.按样框法测定机收或人工收获的总损失率：分层统计落粒、漏割、脱粒夹带等损失量，以实: Sample-quadrat method measures total machine or manual harvest loss: tally shattered, missed-cut, and threshing-entrained losses, using measured recoverable total (theoretical yield - actual harvest + all losses) as denominator. Wheat and rice machine harvest loss is generally required <=2.5%-3.0%; exceeding prompts adjusting header height, drum speed, and travel speed.
map.测定联合收割机作业损失：损失率 = 落粒+漏割+夹带损失量 / 实测可收总量 ×: Measure combine harvester operation loss: loss rate = (shatter + missed-cut + entrained) / measured recoverable total x 100%.
map.对比机收与人工收割的损失差异，评估机械化经济性。: Compare machine vs manual harvest loss differences to assess mechanization economy.
map.按国标 GB/T 8097 谷物收获损失测定方法布点取样。: Lay out sampling points per national standard GB/T 8097 grain harvest loss measurement method.
map.在 2 m×0.5 m 样框内收集落粒 18 g，样框对应面积可收穗粒折算 62: Within a 2 m x 0.5 m quadrat, 18 g of shattered grain was collected; the quadrat's recoverable ear grain converts to 620 g, so plot loss rate = 18/620 ~ 2.9%. If multi-point field average reaches 3.0%, near the wheat machine-harvest excellent standard of <=2.5%, fine-tune header and speed.
map.机收损失率多少算合格？: What machine-harvest loss rate is acceptable?
map.小麦、水稻机收总损失率一般要求≤2.5%~3.0%（视作物与机型），玉米籽粒直收: Wheat and rice machine-harvest total loss generally <=2.5%-3.0% (varies by crop and model); corn grain direct harvest is slightly higher. Exceeding indicates header height, drum speed, or travel speed need adjustment.
map.取样点怎么布才准？: How to lay out sampling points accurately?
map.按对角线或棋盘法在全田随机布 10~20 个样框，避开地头转弯段；每块地单独统计: Place 10-20 quadrats randomly across the field by diagonal or checkerboard method, avoiding headland turning zones; count each plot separately, avoid using a single point for the whole field.
map.机械收获损失率标准≤3%，人工收获≤2%: Machine harvest loss standard <=3%, manual harvest <=2%
map.田间落粒损失受作物品种、成熟度和天气影响: Field shatter loss is affected by crop variety, maturity, and weather
map.机械收获应调整割台高度、转速和清选风量: Machine harvest should adjust header height, speed, and cleaning airflow
map.最佳收获期为蜡熟末期至完熟初期: Best harvest window is late waxy-ripe to early full-ripe
map.收获后应及时晾晒，含水率超标会增加储存损失: After harvest, dry promptly; excess moisture raises storage loss
map.收获损失率评估工具，输入理论产量和实际收获量，计算总损失率并分项评估田间落粒和脱: Harvest loss rate assessment tool: enter theoretical yield and actual harvest to compute total loss rate and assess field shatter and threshing/cleaning losses by category.
